## Change

Choose a [contribution path](https://github.com/HareliField/OpenCity/blob/main/docs/collaboration.md#choose-a-contribution-path). Describe the change and name the model ID, place, or system it affects. Link a shared issue and related PRs for a collaborative feature.

## Try it

Include the model preview ID or game start location and the shortest steps to see the change. Give weather or time when relevant.

## Evidence

Record the checks you ran and their results. Include a screenshot or clip when it shows a visible change. List any paths, systems or conditions you could not verify.

## Asset sources

List new or revised assets, their sources and redistribution terms. Write “None” if there are no asset changes.

## Review scope

Choose standard or maintainer review using the [city rulebook](https://github.com/HareliField/OpenCity/blob/main/docs/collaboration.md#city-rulebook). Call out any shared systems, street geometry, or release changes and how to undo them.

- [ ] I tried the local preview or reviewed its evidence and approved submitting this change.
